title: Nagin Ka Inteqam
desc: A gang of poachers forcibly try to obtain a stone from two snakes and end up killing one while the other escapes. The second snake then uses a young girl to avenge the death of her partner.

title: Haathi Mere Saathi
desc: Devastated by a minister's plans to raze a thriving forest and turn it into an urban settlement, a lone man decides to protect the jungle and its residents.

title: I
desc: A bodybuilder and successful model plans revenge after his enemies inject him with a substance that deforms his body.

title: Saajan Chale Sasural
desc: After Shyamsunder presumes that his first wife Pooja died in a flood, he marries Divya. When he learns that Pooja is alive, he has to juggle between his wives, keeping both his marriages a secret.

title: Valatty
desc: Upon falling in love, Tomy and Amalu, two dogs, expect babies together against the wishes of their families. However, when they decide to run away, Amalu gets kidnapped, creating more problems.

title: Aparichit - The Stranger
desc: A meek lawyer, frustrated with his inability to change the system, develops a vigilante alter-ego to mete out justice to criminals. However, the police soon set out to track down the vigilante.
